title: Aukcion
description: The mod adds a sophisticated auction that is implemented by trading diamonds through your balance.
body:
This mod allows you to add your own auction to any server. It's implemented by converting diamonds into virtual currency using the "/obmenAlm" command, which can be added and withdrawn from a special menu. It also implements a search mechanic for any item at the auction using "/aukcion [search]".
The auction itself is opened with the "/aukcion" command, which will containAll items added by players on this server.
Admins also have an automatic auction house cleaning system for items that are more than 24 hours old.
As a bonus, there's a command "/maxpredmetauk <число>" that allows you to configure how many items each player on the server can add to the auction house to prevent clutter.
To view all commands available in the mod, type "/aukhelp" and you'll receive full, detailed instructions for all commands in chat.
